findings.title: Explicit-v4 (V2) cognition projection silently dropped familiarity-priority retrieved evidence
findings.contract_violated: RELATIONSHIP_FAMILIARITY_RETRIEVED_EVIDENCE_COGNITION_INTEGRATION_V0 (selected validated Memory evidence joins the SAME cognition provider context)
findings.evidence: buildCognitiveContextProjectionInternal dispatched v4 snapshots to buildExplicitV4CognitiveContextProjection(snapshot, factualEvidence), which never accepted `additionalRecentRetrievalRefs`; recent_retrieval_refs was set only from snapshot.memory_state.recent_retrieval_trace (always empty, see AUD-24). The v3 path merged the refs. The integration was therefore inert on the production explicit-v4 path; the trace still reported selected refs.
findings.root_cause: The v4 dispatch added a builder that did not forward the retrieval-augmentation parameter; regression untested because the existing test uses subject-state-v3.
findings.fix: Thread additionalRecentRetrievalRefs into buildExplicitV4CognitiveContextProjection and merge into recent_retrieval_refs (dedup + raw-ASCII sort) exactly as the v3 path.

findings.title: CHARACTEROS_DISABLE_ADAPTATION did not disable belief/relationship adaptation (display-only)
findings.contract_violated: ProductProviderBundleV0 contract: null provider = DISABLED (no provider calls); the configuration flag is named and displayed as disabling adaptation
findings.evidence: beliefSemanticProvider and relationshipFamiliarityAdmissionProvider were constructed unconditionally; configuration.disable_adaptation.value only gated diagnostics.enable('BELIEF_ADAPTATION') and the progress-display turnPlan flags. product-runtime.ts omits providers only when null, so both adaptation providers were always passed to the session.
findings.root_cause: The flag was wired to presentation instead of the dependency graph.
findings.fix: When disable_adaptation is true, both providers resolve to null and both adaptation diagnostics stages stay disabled; turnPlan flags mirror it.

findings.title: Retrieval selected a payload's self-declared episode_ref instead of its manifest binding
findings.contract_violated: Manifest membership is the selection authority; a bound entry's payload identity must match its ref
findings.evidence: views.push({ episode_ref: record.episode_ref, ... }) used the payload field with no comparison to the enumerating entry.ref; validateMemoryRetrievalResult only checks episode-kind and sort order, so a mismatched ref could be written into working_refs.
findings.root_cause: Authority inverted on one field: manifest enumerates but payload identity is selected.
findings.fix: After schema validation, skip when record.episode_ref !== entry.ref (unbound payload never selected).

findings.title: Lawful appraisal abstention crashed mandatory pending lifecycle work
findings.contract_violated: Abstention (INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT) is TERMINAL: no record dimensions, no Affect eligibility, cognition proceeds (documented §18/§58); the pre-cognition path already accepted it
findings.evidence: After a lawful abstention, applyForEvent returned {kind:'NOT_ELIGIBLE'} and completePendingLifecycleWork threw 'AffectApplication must commit ... (NOT_ELIGIBLE)', failing the turn for a path the contract declares terminal and non-fatal.
findings.root_cause: Missing NOT_ELIGIBLE terminal branch in pending lifecycle work.
findings.fix: Treat NOT_ELIGIBLE as a lawful terminal no-Affect skip (record appraisal_ref, continue); every other non-commit outcome still fails closed.

findings.title: Stale/rolled-back store accepted on restore (silent canonical rollback)
findings.contract_violated: Checkpoint durable identity records the authoritative head; restore must not accept a head older or different than the checkpoint's
findings.evidence: adversarial.json (pre-fix): restoring newer.durable + older.store succeeded with origin SUBJECT_RESTORED at state_revision 6 while durable claimed 15 (rollback_accepted=true). The minted head came exclusively from source.bundles.at(-1); durable.identity was never used as a gate.
findings.root_cause: Checkpoint identity was classified observational (EXACT/EXPECTED_RECONSTRUCTED_IDENTITY) but never enforced.
findings.fix: After authoritative restore, fail closed when the restored state revision or head commit_ref differs from durable.identity (when revision > 0).

findings.title: External observation replay duplicates lived experience
findings.contract_violated: External observation FIRST/REPLAY/CONFLICT semantics; one external event must not become two durable episodes
findings.evidence: adversarial.json: two commitExternalObservation calls with the identical input {observation_id:'observation:replay-1', source_refs:['source:sensor-a'], external_refs:['event:external-1']} produced distinct transition ids and distinct episode refs (duplicate_experience=true). The Observation transition id binds expected_state_revision, which advances, and commitExternalObservation deliberately bypasses the conversation ingress ledger.
findings.root_cause: Idempotency key includes mutable revision and no external-observation ledger exists.
findings.fix: Dedicated slice: derive external Observation identity from (subject_id, observation_id) without revision, or add a subject-scoped external-observation ledger with REPLAY/CONFLICT. Changing the frozen identity derivation is a chain-wide law change and must not be done opportunistically.
findings.test: research/audits/core-comprehensive-integrity-audit-v0/adversarial.mjs (probe); regression test deferred to the dedicated slice

findings.title: Transition-identity journal is not persisted; idempotency is not durable across restart
findings.contract_violated: The identity journal is the durable idempotency authority across restart
findings.evidence: SessionDurableStateV0 has no journal field; restore constructs a fresh empty InMemoryTransitionIdentityJournal (reference.ts:134). rebuildFromCommittedBundles exists (journal.ts:687) but has no runtime caller. CAS does not check transition_id uniqueness.
findings.root_cause: Infrastructure durability gap in the session persistence layer.
findings.fix: Dedicated slice: persist journal.exportState() / importState(), or call rebuildFromCommittedBundles(source.bundles) during restore. Live misuse is currently bounded because transition ids bind expected_state_revision (which advances), but the durability contract is unmet.

findings.title: checkpoint_ref is computed but never verified on restore
findings.contract_violated: checkpoint_ref is a content-addressed binding of session/subject/index/environment/durable
findings.evidence: restoreFromSource never recomputes or compares checkpoint_ref; environment.restoreState(checkpoint.environment_state) and ledger states are trusted as-is.
findings.root_cause: Verification not implemented on the read side.
findings.fix: Recompute hashEnvelope over the checkpoint body and require equality before touching state.

findings.title: Long-horizon restoreFromSource did not bind checkpoint subject to configured subject
findings.contract_violated: A checkpoint belongs to exactly one subject (the interactive path already enforces this)
findings.evidence: restoreFromSource called rebuilt.authority.setSubjectId(options.subject.subject_id) without comparing checkpoint.subject_id, so subject A's snapshot could be surfaced under subject B's id.
findings.root_cause: Missing subject-binding guard on the restore seam.
findings.fix: Return a FAILED SessionRestoreOutcomeV0 when checkpoint.subject_id !== options.subject.subject_id.

findings.title: Conversation prompt citeable-ref list diverges from the enforced evidence allowlist
findings.contract_violated: cognitive-prompt-projection.ts declares the rendered citeable list is the exact allowedEvidenceSet; the conversation renderer hand-rolls a 5-source subset that omits current_observation_ref
findings.evidence: allowedEvidenceSet adds current_observation_ref; conversation buildConversationSubjectData does not. The V0 renderer uses allowedEvidenceSet(projection) exactly. conversation-cognition-provider.test.ts:369 documents the subset as intentional ('a lawful SUBSET of the enforced allowlist').
findings.root_cause: Two prompt surfaces diverged; one was updated, the other documented the divergence.
findings.fix: Render from allowedEvidenceSet (or make the validator authority match the documented subset) so the prompt and the executable authority agree. Behavioural change; deferred to a reviewed slice.

findings.title: Canonical affect prompt line has no interpretation legend
findings.contract_violated: Projection semantic interoperability: the model must be able to interpret canonical state
findings.evidence: Rendered exactly as `[affect (canonical)] valence=<n> activation=<n>` with no legend anywhere in either system prompt. The only definition is an unreachable source comment: valence ∈ [-1,1] (−1 negative pole, 0 neutral, +1 positive pole), activation ∈ [0,1]. Beliefs, familiarity and personality each carry explicit legends; affect does not. An LLM assuming valence ∈ [0,1] reads ~0 as extremely negative instead of neutral.
findings.root_cause: The frozen projection intentionally avoided named emotions but never added the numeric legend, unlike sibling sections.
findings.fix: Add the frozen numeric semantics to the affect line (no named emotions, no new ontology). This changes prompt bytes, so it needs its own reviewed slice and re-validation against the affect experiment.

findings.title: Cognition sees canonical Affect BEFORE the current event's AffectApplication (one-turn lag)
findings.contract_violated: none proven — deliberate ordering; but experiments and readers may assume the current event's affect is visible to its own cognition
findings.evidence: trace.json: at turn N the cognition affect line equals the post-time-recovery, post-prior-pending affect, not affect_after_turn. Turn 1's negative impulse (−0.1988) first appears in turn 2's cognition line (−0.1975 after recovery). Order: advanceTime → completePendingLifecycleWork(prior) → admitEvent → context → respond(appraisal, cognition, language) → completePendingLifecycleWork(current) → delivery → memory.
findings.root_cause: Appraisal is explicitly pre-cognition; AffectApplication for the current event is deliberately post-cognition.
findings.fix: Document the ordering as load-bearing (or, if intended otherwise, move current-event AffectApplication before the projection build). Do not change silently: it changes every affect-sensitive cognition input.

findings.title: Generic Learning idempotency is revision-bound, not event-addressed
findings.contract_violated: WRITE_CARDINALITY_V0 — EXACTLY_ONE_RECORD_PER_VALID_LEARNING
findings.evidence: Learning transition id and episode_ref bind expected_state_revision / intent_identity; there is no durable check that the source observation was already encoded (contrast the feedback path's event-addressed membership check that returns ALREADY_COMPLETED). Re-offering the same committed Observation after the revision advanced derives a new id and a new episode.
findings.root_cause: Idempotency keyed on revision rather than event identity.
findings.fix: Reject when the visible record set already binds the source observation_ref, or include observation_ref in the episode-ref projection. Related to AUD-07 (durable idempotency scaffolding).

findings.title: Ordinary retrieval anchors its semantic dimension on the just-created current observation ref
findings.contract_violated: SEMANTIC retrieval dimension is effectively unreachable
findings.evidence: The retrieval query sets semantic_reference = snapshot.context.current_observation_ref, freshly minted per turn; no prior episode can reference a future observation ref, so `view.references.includes(semantic_reference)` is false for all candidates. Ranking then ties on constant entity/context overlap and is decided by declared salience (0.5) and recency.
findings.root_cause: Query anchor is an event identity that cannot exist in prior memory.
findings.fix: Anchor on a stable context/entity/relationship reference. Changes retrieval semantics; needs its own slice and re-validation of memory-dependent experiments.

findings.title: recent_retrieval_trace is never populated (recent-retrieval evidence channel is dead)
findings.contract_violated: retrieval_trace_ref channel appears live in schemas and evidence unions but is always null/empty
findings.evidence: The retrieval result literal hardcodes retrieval_trace_ref: null; commitObservableContext writes [] to recent_retrieval_trace. recent_retrieval_refs is consequently empty except for the familiarity-selected refs added by AUD-01's fix.
findings.root_cause: Trace-pointer production never implemented.
findings.fix: Implement a deterministic trace ref or remove the channel from the evidence union.

findings.title: Belief adaptation is wired and invoked but its effect is unreachable
findings.contract_violated: none — but the surface advertises an active belief adaptation that can never change credence
findings.evidence: Genesis BeliefState is always empty; the workflow handles EXISTING propositions only and never constructs INSERT; with no candidate ids the wiring returns SKIPPED_NO_CANDIDATE_PROPOSITIONS forever. A per-turn belief semantic provider call is still made in product (OllamaBeliefSemanticProviderV0).
findings.root_cause: No lawful INSERT admission path exists.
findings.fix: Add one lawful evidence-bound INSERT path, or mark belief adaptation DORMANT and remove the per-turn call. Not an audit-time fix.
findings.test: belief-transition-executor tests cover INSERT in isolation, not product reachability

findings.title: BeliefTransitionExecutor is root-exported and commits arbitrary evidence-bound credence without the plasticity capability
findings.contract_violated: Belief credence should come only from a host-minted, capability-gated plasticity result
findings.evidence: The executor is exported from the runtime barrel; execute() validates schema, subject and evidence visibility only, then issues its own producer authorization via the injected issuer. The plasticity gate lives in the workflow, not the executor.
findings.root_cause: Commit authority object reachable independent of the capability-gated producer chain.
findings.fix: Do not root-export the executor, or require an opaque admitted plasticity result for UPDATE.

findings.title: Relationship counterpart ref is hardcoded to entity:alice
findings.contract_violated: Session counterpart identity should derive from session configuration
findings.evidence: SESSION_COUNTERPART_REF_V0 = 'entity:alice' constant; registration, observation entity sets and familiarity ingestion all derive from it regardless of configured subject/counterpart.
findings.root_cause: Single-session constant, not configuration-derived.
findings.fix: Derive the counterpart ref from session configuration or fail closed when not explicitly established.

findings.title: Stale constant PRODUCTION_GOVERNED_RELATIONSHIP_WRITER_AUTHORITY_V0 = NONE contradicts the wired governed writer
findings.contract_violated: documentation/constant drift
findings.evidence: Production runs relationship-interaction-familiarity-ingestion which evaluates the governed write and commits with a prepared governed writer authority token.
findings.root_cause: Stale constant.
findings.fix: Update or remove the constant; keep the authoritative statement in one place.

findings.title: NOT_DECISION_ADMISSIBLE returns reason 'UNREGISTERED_FEATURE' even for the registered familiarity feature
findings.contract_violated: reason literal is false for an admitted dimension
findings.evidence: decision_admission is correctly NOT_DECISION_ADMISSIBLE, but the reason literal is UNREGISTERED_FEATURE for all ids.
findings.root_cause: Single default reason string.
findings.fix: Use a distinct reason for registered-but-not-decision-admissible dimensions.

findings.title: Personality is ABSENT and unbootstrappable in the default product while adaptation surfaces are advertised
findings.contract_violated: none — product honesty is preserved (prints ABSENT), but the API advertises a dormant capability
findings.evidence: No genesis prior and no personality semantic provider are supplied; personality_adaptation_enabled=false; plasticity fails closed on empty Personality and never invents dimensions. Belief/relationship are wired, personality is not.
findings.root_cause: Product composition asymmetry.
findings.fix: Either wire a genesis prior + semantic provider, or document Personality as dormant for the product.
findings.test: personality-lived-evidence.test.ts exercises the chain with a supplied prior, not the default product

findings.title: durable.identity.affect is never read or verified on restore
findings.contract_violated: none — the canonical head is authoritative; the checkpoint field is observational
findings.evidence: Restore reconstructs affect from the canonical head bundle; durable.identity.affect is only consumed by zero-tick time-advance reporting without comparison.
findings.root_cause: Observational field treated as data by one reporter.
findings.fix: Verify durable.identity.affect against the restored snapshot (fail closed) or stop presenting it as authoritative.

findings.title: Bounded-affect dynamics declares gain/bound constants that the equations do not consume
findings.contract_violated: declared configuration is not the source of truth
findings.evidence: gains {valence:0.25, activation:0.1} and bounds {[-1,1],[0,1]} are declared but the impulse equations hardcode 0.25/0.1 and clamp literals -1/1, 0/1; only tau_ticks and baseline.activation are read.
findings.root_cause: Literal duplication.
findings.fix: Consume the constants or delete them.
findings.test: numbers agree today, so no test fails

findings.title: Language prompt refers to an undefined 'LAWFUL MEMORY EVIDENCE' section and the enforced allowlist is broader than the memory-only input
findings.contract_violated: prompt tells the model to cite only refs from a section that is never rendered; enforcement permits focus/entity/environment/observation refs
findings.evidence: System rules 2/5 mention LAWFUL MEMORY EVIDENCE; no rendered section carries that label; the input evidence_refs list is memory-only while lawful_evidence_refs is allowedEvidenceSet.
findings.root_cause: Prompt and enforcement derived from different sets.
findings.fix: Render the allowlist explicitly or restrict enforcement to the memory-only set.

findings.title: Language episode read uses the pre-appraisal repository revision
findings.contract_violated: authoritative repository-revision binding of the episode content reader
findings.evidence: snapshot is read before the pre-cognition appraisal; only sourceRevision (state_revision) is refreshed. realize/clarify branches still read episode content against the pre-appraisal snapshot.memory_state.repository_revision; the post-language stale check compares state_revision only.
findings.root_cause: Stale snapshot handle passed through the post-appraisal branch.
findings.fix: Re-read the snapshot after appraisal and compare repository_revision too. Conditional impact (episodes are immutable), hence low priority.

findings.title: Raw scene/task interpolation into prompt lines (format injection surface)
findings.contract_violated: none — SUBJECT DATA is declared untrusted and downstream gates bound the damage
findings.evidence: scene/task are canonical NFC text that may contain newlines/quotes and are interpolated unescaped; factual memory text is JSON.stringify-escaped.
findings.root_cause: Inconsistent escaping.
findings.fix: JSON.stringify scene/task.

findings.title: Language draft text is not semantically grounded (false statements possible in the observable reply)
findings.contract_violated: none structural — behavior is non-canonical and cannot create memories
findings.evidence: Only gates are strict JSON, input_hash echo, non-empty ≤4096 text, and evidence_refs ⊆ allowlist. Nothing verifies that text is supported by cited refs.
findings.root_cause: Inherent to free-text realization.
findings.fix: None required structurally; note that 'cannot create false memories' is true only of canonical state, not of the reply text.

findings.title: Belief decision/arbitration/tendency chain is unreachable in the product
findings.contract_violated: none — foundation slice
findings.evidence: produceBeliefDecisionSelectionV0 and the cognition-relation provider are exported but never constructed under product/.
findings.root_cause: Not wired by design.
findings.fix: None unless arbitration is meant to gate behavior.

findings.title: projection_hash does not bind the allowed action space on the V0/V1 conversation path
findings.contract_violated: documented design gap
findings.evidence: The hash is computed over a body with allowed_actions: [], then the host action space is appended after hashing; the transition id binds it separately and the V1 relation path uses action_space_fingerprint.
findings.root_cause: Hash scoped to state evidence.
findings.fix: None in-tree (no exploit); include the space in the hashed body if the binding is desired.

findings.title: Familiarity read projection is omitted from the V0 renderer
findings.contract_violated: none — the influence line is self-contained
findings.evidence: V0 renderer renders the influence but not presence/ordinal_level; V1 and the conversation renderer render both.
findings.root_cause: Surface divergence.
findings.fix: none

sound_areas: Affect canonical shape and validator (closed, finite, bounds, negative-zero rejection, no coercion)
Affect impulse + recovery equations (sign, weights, clamp-after-add, contractive time decay toward baseline (0,0.2))
Appraisal exact-input reuse (turn-local, request-identity key, only model-generated candidate dimensions reused; authority/event refs rebuilt; re-validated and re-bound)
Appraisal dimension validation (closed keys, finite [0,1], attribution enum, no clamp/repair/fallback; no misspelled-key acceptance)
Regulation reference producer (byte-exact zero-dynamics; only last_update changes)
Belief contracts: subjective-endorsement credence, stance=2c-1 exact, UNIQUE_POSITIVE_MAX with ties/≤0 → NO_SELECTION; empty genesis with no fabricated credence
Relationship governed write gate (epoch/history proof fail-closed; reserved dimension never in relationship_dimensions; no familiarity-as-trust leakage)
Personality/P0 purity (no 0.5 default, no fabricated neutral; distinct traits_seed vs P(t) with explicit prompt semantics)
Canonical commit chain (producer authorization WeakSet, identity rebinding, exact authorization-set equality, single CAS, checksum/commit_ref recomputation, full chain replay on restore)
WeakSet capability idiom rejects JSON/spread/structuredClone; restore mints fresh authority
Logical time derivation (ticks/occurrence only; no wall clock in canonical state)
External observation has no appraisal/affect side effects by design
Conversation ingress FIRST/REPLAY/CONFLICT with re-derived refs and tamper detection
No legacy galaxy/attractor/particle paths reachable in production (comments only)
